cards.summary: Naboo was a bountiful planet in the Chommell sector of the Mid Rim, in the Trailing Sectors and close to the border of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the indigenous Gungan species and to a population of humans known as the Naboo. Naboo was pushed to the forefront of galactic politics as the birthplace of…

cards.name: Jyn Erso
cards.summary: Jyn Erso, known by the aliases Kestrel Dawn, Jyn Dawn, Tanith Ponta, Liana Hallik, Lyra Rallik, and Nari McVee, was a human female soldier and former criminal who became a pivotal member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic when she led Rogue One in stealing the Death Star plans during the Battle of Scarif. She…

cards.name: Mas Amedda
cards.summary: Mas Amedda was a Chagrian male politician who served as Vice Chair of the Galactic Republic during the late Republic Era and later as the Grand Vizier of the Galactic Empire. Hailing from the Inner Rim planet Champala, Amedda rose to the position of Vice Chair of the Republic Senate with his impeccable political…

cards.name: Even Piell
cards.summary: Even Piell, a Force-sensitive Lannik male, was a Jedi Master who served as a senior member of the Jedi High Council in the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era. A native of the politically unstable planet Lannik, the battle-hardened Piell was regarded as brusque and bellicose and was renowned as a warrior and…

cards.name: Avar Kriss
cards.summary: Avar Kriss was a human female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Noble and selfless, Kriss was an inspiration to many of her fellow Jedi. She served on the Starlight Beacon, a space station on the frontier of the galaxy. Kriss was heavily involved in the aftermath of the hyperspace…

cards.name: Cad Bane
cards.summary: Cad Bane, formerly known as Colby, was a Duros male bounty hunter and mercenary in the galaxy whose career spanned from the fall of the Galactic Republic, the reign of the Galactic Empire and into the era of the New Republic. Once a street rat, Bane first became involved in criminal activity when he joined the…

cards.name: Kelnacca
cards.summary: Kelnacca was a Force-sensitive Wookiee who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, Kelnacca was sent to the crash site of the Starlight Beacon space station on the planet Eiram to help with the relief effort. There, he was introduced to Padawan Yarzion Vell, whose master…

cards.name: Ruescott Melshi
cards.summary: Ruescott Melshi was a human male who, growing up, came to resent the Galactic Empire, the successor state of the Galactic Republic. By 5 BBY, he was imprisoned and forced to labor at the Imperial Prison Complex on the moon Narkina 5, producing complex machinery bound for the Empire's secret superweapon, the Death…

cards.name: Cere Junda
cards.summary: Cere Junda was a Force-sensitive human female Jedi Master who mentored Padawan Cal Kestis in the ways of the Force during the rise of the Galactic Empire. At one time she was trained as the Padawan of Jedi Master Eno Cordova, before graduating to the rank of Jedi Knight and taking Trilla Suduri as her own apprentice.

cards.name: Qi'ra
cards.summary: Lady Qi'ra was a human female crime lord from the planet Corellia who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She grew up on the streets along with Han as part of the White Worms. Though they were at first rivals, the two scrumrats eventually became lovers. Sometime after Qi'ra was made Head Girl by Lady…

cards.name: Ochi
cards.summary: Ochi, known as Ochi of Bestoon, was a Bestoonian male Sith assassin and Jedi hunter from the planet Bestoon with a career spanning decades, from the twilight of the Galactic Republic, and the subsequent rise of the Galactic Empire to the era of the New Republic. Ochi possessed a personal Sith dagger used to commit…

cards.name: Jedha
cards.summary: Jedha, also known as the Pilgrim Moon, the Cold Moon, or the Kyber Heart, and formerly known as NiJedha, was a small desert moon which orbited the planet NaJedha. Located in the Jedha system of the galaxy's Mid Rim, the moon had a cold climate due to its lasting winter. The historical and spiritual significance of…

cards.name: Temmin Wexley
cards.summary: Temmin "Snap" Wexley was a human male who lived during the Age of the Empire and the time of the New Republic. At a young age, Temmin was separated from his parents after his father Brentin was taken away by the Galactic Empire and his mother Norra Wexley joined the Rebel Alliance. He became an independent…

cards.name: Greez Dritus
cards.summary: Greez Dritus was a Latero male who lived during the end of the Galactic Republic and into the Imperial Era. He was captain of the Stinger Mantis, a luxury yacht with controls customized for piloting with his four arms. The former Jedi Cere Junda, on a personal mission to rebuild the Jedi Order, hired him as her…

cards.name: Wedge Antilles
cards.summary: Wedge Antilles, known as TIE SS-2-5 during his time at Skystrike Academy, was a renowned human male starfighter pilot from Corellia who first served in the Imperial Navy as a TIE fighter pilot until defecting to join the rebellion. He would also serve in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and years later the New…

cards.name: Plo Koon
cards.summary: Plo Koon was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor Jedi Master who served as a noble member of the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He served as a respected Jedi General during the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict between the Republic and its splinter state, the Confederacy of Independent…

cards.name: Yarael Poof
cards.summary: Yarael Poof was a Quermian Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era through the final years of the Galactic Republic. He was both an expert practitioner of Jedi mind tricks and illusions and a skilled diplomat and teacher. Following the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Chancellor Lina…

cards.name: Crosshair
cards.summary: Crosshair, formerly designated CT-9904, was a veteran clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as part of Clone Force 99. Crosshair possessed genetic mutations that gave him exceptional eyesight and marksmanship skills. As a result, he acted as a sniper and a long-range…

cards.name: Dathomir
cards.summary: Dathomir was a remote, verdant, and dangerous planet of the Dathomir system in the Outer Rim Territories' Quelii sector. Strongly influenced by the dark side of the Force, the world had varied terrains all dimly bathed in blood-red light, and it was home to plenty of vegetation and predators who preyed on each…

cards.name: Arihnda Pryce
cards.summary: Arihnda Pryce was a Lothalite human female who served as the Galactic Empire's imperial Governor of the planet Lothal under the jurisdiction of Moff Stattata. Deceitful and opportunistic, Pryce rose to political power and gained the position of Planetary Governor through underhanded tactics and power plays. Under…

cards.name: Breha Organa
cards.summary: Breha Organa was a human female Alderaanian who served as queen of her homeworld of Alderaan during the final decades of the Galactic Republic and was one of the founding members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Following the rise of the Galactic Empire at the end of the Clone Wars, Alderaan became a source…

cards.name: Ghost
cards.summary: The Ghost was a modified VCX-100 light freighter owned by the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla that was used by the Spectres rebel cell during the Age of the Empire. As part of the rebellion, the Ghost saw actions on numerous missions and skirmishes against the forces of the Galactic Empire. The Ghost also had an auxiliary…

cards.name: Lothal
cards.summary: Lothal was a planet in the Outer Rim Territories. During the early years of the Galactic Empire, Lothal was in a state of economic disrepair and invited the Empire to take over the planet's industries, with the promise of prosperity and security. Although many people said the Empire would bring doom, their…

cards.name: Sana Starros
cards.summary: Sana Starros, also called Sanisi by her family, was a human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was once a student at the University of Bar'leth, where she had a romantic relationship with Chelli Lona Aphra. Later, she claimed to be married to Han Solo, though he denied it, and…

cards.name: Pijal
cards.summary: Pijal was a terrestrial planet located in the Inner Rim Territories' Pijal system that was connected to the hyperspace route known as the Pijal Hyperspace Corridor. The world had a moon nearly as large as itself and was affected by solar flares from its sun roughly every decade. Pijal's surface consisted of small,…

cards.name: Lightsaber combat
cards.summary: Lightsaber combat occurred when two or more opponents using lightsabers, or at least one of the combatants used a lightsaber while the other used a different bladed weapon, engaged in a duel. Such opponents were often, though not always, Sith and Jedi. Though lightsaber combat decided the results of some important…

cards.name: Darksaber
cards.summary: The Darksaber was an ancient and unique black-bladed lightsaber created by Tarre Vizsla, the first Mandalorian ever inducted into the Jedi Order, around 1050 BBY. The weapon was kept in the Jedi Temple after Vizsla's passing, but members of House Vizsla stole the saber in a conflict with the Jedi during the fall of…

cards.name: Darth Vader's lightsaber
cards.summary: Darth Vader's lightsaber was the third and final lightsaber personally built by Anakin Skywalker after he became Darth Vader, a Sith Lord who served as Darth Sidious' last apprentice and Commander-in-Chief of the Galactic Empire's military. He built the weapon after he lost his previous lightsaber during a skirmish…

cards.name: Imperial holdouts
cards.summary: Imperial holdouts, also known as Imperial remnants or as Imperial hideouts, were various fractured political and military remnants of the Galactic Empire which emerged following its collapse and prevailed throughout the first few years of the New Republic Era.

cards.name: Braha'tok-class gunship
cards.summary: The Braha'tok-class gunship, also known as the Dornean gunship or shortened to Braha'tok, was a model of gunship designed by the Dornean species and built by the Dornean Braha'ket Fleetworks Conglomerate to protect the Dornean homeworld, Dornea, and its star system from the Galactic Empire. Standing at 90 meters…

cards.name: Pelta-class frigate
cards.summary: The Pelta-class frigate was a versatile and long-used model of frigate manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards that had several different configured variants. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance, the frigates were used by the Republic Navy as a critical component of its war effort.…

cards.name: Yoda's species
cards.summary: The species to which the Jedi Grand Master Yoda belonged was ancient and shrouded in mystery. Members of this species were rarely seen anywhere in the galaxy. The few members of this species seen in the galaxy were all Force-sensitive, and the species' homeworld and name were unknown.

cards.name: Jedi Vector
cards.summary: The Vector was instrumental in rescue operations during the Great Hyperspace Disaster of the Hetzal system and the catastrophes known as Emergences that followed. After the freighter Legacy Run was mysteriously destroyed in hyperspace, passenger compartments and debris from the ship began to enter realspace across…

cards.name: Quarren
cards.summary: The Quarren were a bipedal squid-like species with four facial tentacles which protruded from their lower jaw. Their skin-color range included various hues of orange, salmon, tan, pink, and purple. They had a pair of deep turquoise eyes, finned hands with suction-tipped fingers, and small tusks on their mouth. In…

cards.name: Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter
cards.summary: The Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter, also known as the Ginivex series and the Geonosian fanblade starfighter, was a model of starfighter manufactured by Huppla Pasa Tisc Shipwrights Collective. It was flown by Sith apprentice and Separatist commander Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars against the Galactic…

cards.name: Superweapon
cards.summary: Superweapons or megaweapons were weapons of extremely devastating power, ranging from the capacity to destroy a city to entire planets.

cards.name: GR-75 medium transport
cards.summary: The GR-75 medium transport, sometimes referred to as the Gallofree transport, was a transport designed and constructed by Gallofree Yards, Inc.. They were lightly armed with a clamshell-like hull to protect the cargo pods it carried. They could not reach anymore than 650 kilometers per hour and had a class 4…

cards.name: Dooku's lightsaber
cards.summary: Dooku's lightsaber, also known as Darth Tyranus' lightsaber, or Dooku's Sith lightsaber, was the personal curved-hilt lightsaber of Dooku, the Count of Serenno. The former Jedi Master, who became Darth Tyranus and the political leader of the Separatist Alliance, had originally constructed the weapon's unusual hilt…

cards.name: N-1 starfighter
cards.summary: The N-1 starfighter, also referred to as the Royal Naboo N-1 starfighter, Naboo N-1 starfighter, Naboo starfighter, N-1 fighter, or more simply, the N-1, was a single seat patrol craft developed by the Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps and used by the Royal Naboo Security Forces.

cards.name: Sarlacc
cards.summary: Sarlaccs were dangerous, carnivorous creatures located on Tatooine and several other planets throughout the galaxy. It shared common ancestry with other species, including the rathtar, blixus, and vixus. One sarlacc identified as the "almighty Sarlacc" lived in the Great Pit of Carkoon, a depression of sand within…

cards.name: ST-70 M-111 Razor Crest series
cards.summary: The ST-70 M-111 Razor Crest series, also known as the ST-70 assault ship, ST-70 Razor Crest assault ship or simply as the ST-70 class, was a class of gunship manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation. Ships of the class were sometimes informally referred to as a "Razor Crest". Its usage predated the…

cards.name: V-19 Torrent starfighter
cards.summary: The V-19 Torrent starfighter, or the V-19 Torrent Interceptor, was a sturdy, fast, and long-range space superiority starfighter produced by Slayn & Korpil for the Galactic Republic's naval forces. It possessed a flat, broad and roughly square-shaped fuselage with a cockpit mounted far aft on the starfighter's…

cards.name: Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber
cards.summary: Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber, also known as Maul's saberstaff, was the first personal double-bladed lightsaber of Darth Maul, a Sith Lord who took part in the Invasion of Naboo and the Clone Wars. The Sith lightsaber was cut in half by Obi-Wan Kenobi during their duel on Naboo, and Maul continued to use…

cards.name: Z-28 Skywing
cards.summary: The Z-28 Skywing was a model of starfighter utilized by the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. Produced by Incom Corporation, the fighters had an arrowhead shape. The Republic possessed direct control of a number of Skywings, while further squadrons of Skywings were owned by the member worlds of the…

cards.name: Marrok's lightsaber
cards.summary: Marrok's lightsaber was the red double-bladed spinning lightsaber owned by the Inquisitor Marrok, once known as the First Brother. Marrok continued to use the lightsaber after becoming a mercenary by 9 ABY. The saber was capable of switching between crescent mode, single-bladed, and disk mode double-bladed. While…

cards.name: Evereni
cards.summary: The Evereni were a sentient humanoid nomadic species, distinguished by their slate-gray skin and pitch-black eyes. They once hailed from the planet Everon before the Great Storm ravaged their homeworld, which led to centuries of wars between the Evereni people and ultimately forced the survivors to flee into the…

cards.name: Bomber
cards.summary: Bombers were starships designed to strike heavily armored targets, like capital ships or ground artillery. Most of these ships were armed with projectile weapons, such as proton torpedoes, proton bombs, and concussion missiles. Even externally-mounted cargo containers could be used for bombing runs.

cards.name: Yoda's lightsaber
cards.summary: Yoda's lightsaber smaller size was a unique quality matching its wielder's small stature. The weapon had a simple design, consisting of a studded chrome handle with black trim and an emitter shroud. It contained a kyber crystal that put forth a bright green plasma blade.

cards.name: HMP droid gunship
cards.summary: The HMP (Heavy Missile Platform) droid gunship, also known as the HMP Predator gunship, Droid Heavy Missile Platform, or droid gunship, was a model of repulsorlift airspeeder created by Geonosians and manufactured by Baktoid Fleet Ordnance and Haor Chall Engineering Corporation. Operated by an advanced droid brain,…

cards.name: Low Altitude Assault Transport
cards.summary: The Low Altitude Assault Transport, or LAAT, was a line of gunship used by the Grand Army of the Republic. Models in the line included the Low Altitude Assault Transport carrier designed to transport a single All Terrain Tactical Enforcer and the Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry that served mainly as a…

cards.name: Z-95 Headhunter
cards.summary: The Z-95 Headhunter, also referred to as the Z-95 starfighter or simply the Z-95, was a multi-purpose starfighter jointly manufactured by Incom Corporation and Sublights Products Corporation. Despite being considered outdated, the Z-95 was durable and adaptable to a variety of different roles, which led many to…

cards.name: Darth Sidious' lightsabers
cards.summary: Darth Sidious' lightsabers were the pair of nearly identical personal electrum-finish lightsabers of Darth Sidious, built during his apprenticeship under Darth Plagueis. Although a skilled and deadly combatant, Sidious rarely used his weapons—only doing so when absolutely necessary—as he would have been immediately…

cards.name: Interdictor-class Star Destroyer
cards.summary: The Interdictor-class Star Destroyer was a model of Star Destroyer derived from the Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was active during the Imperial Era. The Galactic Empire utilized the Interdictor-class and the other models of the Imperial-class to inspect vessels along their patrol routes. An Interdictor…

cards.name: Fang-class Protectorate fighter
cards.summary: Fang fighters were fast and highly maneuverable starship designed specifically for combat. The craft's narrow attack profile and swivel-mounted wings that provided vectored-thrust control gave the fighter unmatched agility.

cards.name: Reva's lightsaber
cards.summary: While many Inquisitors carried their lightsabers on their backs, the Third Sister kept hers hang on her right side. The saber was able to be split into two separate blades with the ringed emitter retracting at the sides so the hilt can extend and split apart. This allowed Reva to utilize her Jar'Kai skills, which…

cards.name: Law enforcement agency
cards.summary: A law enforcement agency, also referred to as a planetary security force, police force, or security force, was an organization charged with enforcing laws, maintaining order, and protecting life and property. They were staffed by police officers or some cases soldiers and were generally structured as a paramilitary…

cards.name: Sol's lightsaber
cards.summary: The damaged weapon was retrieved by Sol's former Jedi Padawan, and Mae's twin, Verosha Aniseya, who bled its kyber crystal while Force choking Sol for his part in the murder of the twins' mother and as an outburst of her other complex emotions, pain, and anger. Afterwards, Osha took the weapon with her when…

cards.name: Eleventh Brother's lightsaber
cards.summary: A double-bladed spinning lightsaber was utilized by the Eleventh Brother during his time as an Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire. It was similar in appearance to other double-bladed spinning lightsabers wielded by Inquisitors.

cards.name: Vernestra Rwoh's purple-bladed lightsaber
cards.summary: Vernestra Rwoh's purple-bladed lightsaber, also known as Vernestra Rwoh's lightsaber, or as Vernestra's lightsaber, was a purple-bladed lightsaber wielded by Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh during the High Republic Era. Originally an ordinary single-bladed weapon, Rwoh modified it to be able to switch between lightsaber…

cards.name: The Grand Inquisitor's lightsaber
cards.summary: The Grand Inquisitor's lightsaber was the personal double-bladed spinning lightsaber of the Jedi hunter known as the Grand Inquisitor, similar to those wielded by the other Imperial Inquisitors.

cards.name: TIE Avenger prototype
cards.summary: The TIE Avenger prototype was an experimental TIE series starfighter developed for the Galactic Empire and tested by Sienar Fleet Systems. It was heavily armed and armored, carrying an externally-mounted port side dual laser cannon, two anti-personnel rotary blaster cannons, and wing-mounted missiles and torpedoes.…

cards.name: Tri-Wing S-91x Pegasus Starfighter
cards.summary: The Tri-Wing S-91x Pegasus Starfighter, or simply the Tri-wing, was a type of starship that was manufactured by Incom Corporation and later classified as a New Republic Light Assault Starship. It was active during the Imperial Era, with one spotted by Princess Leia Organa on Alderaan in 9 BBY. The Tri-wing…

cards.name: Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter
cards.summary: The Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter, also known simply as the Rogue-class starfighter, Porax-38 starfighter, or P-38 fighter, was a model of starfighter manufactured by Baktoid Armor Workshop and Buuper Torsckil Abbey Devices and used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Often flown by…

cards.name: Regineer Teed's species
cards.summary: A species of sentient humanoid with yellow-and-blue skin and a pair of protruding tusks existed in the galaxy by the time of the reign of the Galactic Empire. Regineer Teed was a member of the species who, in 10 BBY, was part of the Cloud-Riders pirate gang, with the membership of the group being drawn from worlds…

cards.name: Troop transport
cards.summary: A troop transport, also known as a troopship, was a vehicle that ferried troopers.

cards.name: Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel
cards.summary: The Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel, otherwise identified as the DH-Omni Support Vessel, DH-O Support Vessel, or simply as the DH-O and dubbed as the Separatist supply ship or Separatist support ship, or Separatist transport, was a model of massive transport and supply ship manufactured by Hoersch-Kessel Drive,…

cards.name: Gen'Dai
cards.summary: The Gen'Dai were a species of large, sentient beings. Their bodies were made up of a mass of regenerative tentacles, which allowed them to regenerate wounds quickly and, notoriously, be almost impossible to kill. Once a peaceful people, the Gen'Dai became violent nomads centuries before the Imperial Era and after…

cards.name: Interceptor
cards.summary: An interceptor was a starfighter classification typically applied to starships that sacrificed heavy ordnance payloads, armor, deflector shields, and/or a hyperdrive in favor of pure speed and agility in combat. To compensate for the lack of a hyperdrive, some types of interceptors could dock with an external…

cards.name: Theelin
cards.summary: The Theelin were a rare sentient species recognizable by their brightly colored hair and spotted skin.

cards.name: Namara
cards.summary: The Namara were a sentient species distinguished by their black eyes and downward-turning horns that extended from the sides of their heads. Some Namara had a second, smaller pair of forward facing horns on top of their heads and elongated jowls.

cards.name: Dyplotid
cards.summary: Dyplotids were a bipedal humanoid sentient species that were commonly brown, pink, or purple in coloration, possessing two legs, as well as two arms that ended in five-fingered hands. Dyplotids had large craniums, with flat faces that displayed no visible nose. These faces did, however, feature four keen eyes which…

cards.name: Trident-class assault ship
cards.summary: The Trident-class assault ship, also known as the Trident assault ship, Trident drill assault craft, or simply drill assault craft, was a type of assault ship manufactured by Colicoid Creation Nest. They had four durasteel-armored tentacles equipped with magnetic grapples that served both as weapons and as a means…

cards.name: Zeffonian
cards.summary: The Zeffonians, or Zeffo for short, were an ancient sentient species native to the planet Zeffo. Many Zeffonians could wield the Force, which they referred to as the "Life Wind," and those who did became known as sages.

cards.name: Lepi
cards.summary: The Lepi was a sentient species characterized by their lanky frame, long ears, and buck teeth. One notable Lepi was the smuggler Jaxxon.

cards.name: Pooba
cards.summary: Pooba were a bipedal sentient species that lived in the galaxy. They were covered in furry blue hair and had multihued eye color. Two members of the species, Nubs and Barabo, served the Jedi Order as a Jedi youngling and a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era, respectively. Pooba spoke the language Poobian.

cards.name: Omicron-class attack shuttle
cards.summary: The Omicron-class attack shuttle, also known as an Omicron-class shuttle,, Omicron-class gunship or simply, the Omicron was a class of attack shuttle that was active during the Clone Wars. The Marauder, the starship of the Galactic Republic's Clone Force 99, was a modified Omicron-class attack shuttle. Halland Goth…

cards.name: DP20 gunship
cards.summary: The DP20 gunship, also known as the DP20 Frigate or simply as the DP20 and colloquially referred to as the Corellian Gunship, was a warship model manufactured by the Corellian Engineering Corporation. It saw service in the Galactic Republic, the Galactic Empire, and then notably in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

cards.name: Sana Starros' crew
cards.summary: After rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra was possessed by the Spark Eternal, the smuggler Sana Starros and archaeologist Kho Phon Farrus assembled a crew that consisted of her father Korin Aphra, two of her exes, rebel Captain Magna Tolvan and Professor Eustacia Okka, and the University of Bar'leth…

cards.name: Hardcell-class interstellar transport
cards.summary: The Hardcell-class interstellar transport, also known as the Hardcell-class transport, the Hardcell transport, Techno Union transport, or Techno Union starship, was a model of transport manufactured by the Techno Union and utilized by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the First Battle of Geonosis, the…

cards.name: Auzituck anti-slaver gunship
cards.summary: Auzituck roughly translated to "liberated one" in Shyriiwook, the native language of the Wookiees. The gunship was fast, well-armored and heavily armed with a narrow profile and large engines. It had a dual-tiered, bubble-shaped canopy that housed the pilot in the upper, rear section with the copilot and gunner in…

cards.name: Sith cult
cards.summary: A Sith cult was a cult comprised of Sith cultists that followed the Sith religion and worshiped the dark side of the Force. Some cults, such as the Sith Eternal, would worship one or more specific Sith Lords and practice their teachings, sometimes even with the goal of resurrecting the Sith Lord. Some cults were in…

cards.name: Everon
cards.summary: Before the High Republic Era, the Evereni put their trust in their stormy homeworld of Everon in an attempt to live in harmony with nature; however, the Great Storm came, in the form of a vortex storm that rose from the planet's core bringing strong winds and lightning, destroying the native Evereni's civilization.

cards.name: Core Founder
cards.summary: The Core Founders were a group of twenty-two worlds, all located in the Core Worlds region, which founded the Galactic Republic around 25,000 BBY. Founder worlds included Alderaan, Chandrila, Corellia, Coruscant, and Duro. The Avenue of the Core Founders in front of the Galactic Senate Building on Coruscant, the…

cards.name: Anzellan Droidsmiths
cards.summary: The Anzellan Droidsmiths were a legendary crew of four (originally three) Anzellan droidsmiths living on the planet Nevarro. By the time of the New Republic, they found great commercial success when Nevarro was thriving, as they had precise and affordable expertise to keep automated excavation equipment used for…

cards.name: Skeleton Crew
cards.summary: At first, the four younglings divided amongst themselves into two distinct groups. The boys, Wim and Neel, as one group and the girls, Fern and KB, as the other. However, during their adventures, the four, who had initially fought over who had "claimsies" on the ship and who got to be captain, learned to trust one…

cards.name: Nagi
cards.summary: Nagi was a planet that was the homeworld of the Nagai species. During the New Republic Era, a number of Nagai were forcefully removed from their homeworld to the planet Gadrilam by other members of the species. Later, the Zantarrk Gang were informed a few hundred more Nagai were en route from Nagi to them.

cards.name: Leresai Assembly
cards.summary: The Leresai Assembly was an organization active during the High Republic Era. In 231 BBY, the Assembly intercepted several garbled transmissions of the Eye of the Nihil, Marchion Ro, which it passed on to the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic, who were attempting to hunt down the Nihil pirates.

cards.name: Aquillian Ranger
cards.summary: An Aquillian Ranger was a type of individual who was active during the Imperial Era. While starship spotting on Alderaan in 9 BBY, Princess Leia Organa spotted a Tri-Wing S-91x Pegasus Starfighter, and hypothesized that it was an Aquillian Ranger scouting for the Merson pirates.

cards.name: Alderaanian refugee convoy
cards.summary: Following the Disaster, a convoy of Alderaanian survivors aboard three GR-75 medium transports traveled to Fostar Haven in the hopes of evading the Galactic Empire, which was under orders from Darth Vader to destroy all remainders of Alderaan.

cards.name: Varovia
cards.summary: Varovia was a planet located in the galaxy that was the homeworld of the Varovian species. Jedi Master Atticus Cale, his Padawan Jadia Brink, Golo and Tilli traveled to Varovia in search for the missing Jedi Master Barnabas Vim, but had no luck in discovering him on the planet. Instead they destroyed the Rod of…

cards.name: Adelhard coalition
cards.summary: The Adelhard coalition was a faction created late into the Galactic Civil War by Grand Moff Ubrik Adelhard out of scattered Imperial forces, smugglers, and the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

cards.name: Suboreen
cards.summary: Suboreen first appeared in the third issue of the canon comic book series Star Wars, published by Marvel Comics on July 16, 2025.
